purpose: Seed eval set for WO-027 (eLo self-improvement loop). Each case is a real behaviour eLo must get right, seeded from failures we already fixed (WO-015/019/020/022) so they can never silently regress. Judged by LLM-as-judge against `expected` + `must_not`, using the routing/voice traces as evidence.
how_to_score: For each case: run eLo on `input`, capture reply + blender/routing_trace.json + voice_trace.json. LLM-judge returns pass/fail + 0-1 score against `expected` and `must_not`. Low score → escalate to deep model with the trace (WO-026) → re-score.
review_policy: Corrections derived from these cases are HUMAN-REVIEWED before entering injected memory. Voice/personality/routing corrections = David (🔴). — WO-027

cases.input: What's the best way to fix my audio output?
must_not: fire CONNECT/REFLECT/CHALLENGE on a plain factual question
reply with an associative one-liner like 'That ties in' or 'One feeds the other'
cases.anti_pattern_seen: CAL over-fired CONNECT/REFLECT → cryptic non-answer instead of the direct 'check your OS audio output device' answer
cases.judge: Did eLo give a direct, useful answer (route ANSWER), not an associative deflection?

must_not: launch into REFLECT/CHALLENGE
produce 'You keep coming back to narrative'-style unprompted analysis
cases.judge: Did eLo respond conversationally and briefly, without unprompted analysis?

must_not: return a wiki/summary of the term instead of playing it
latch a stale entity from a previous turn
cases.anti_pattern_seen: returned a 'DONE' wiki lookup instead of playing the podcast (tool mis-route + stale-entity latch)
cases.judge: Did eLo route to the play action for the correct current entity, not a web/wiki lookup?

cases.input: (same canned line was about to repeat verbatim across turns)

expected.behaviour: loop-filter suppresses the verbatim repeat, varies or advances

must_not: repeat the identical canned sentence turn after turn
cases.anti_pattern_seen: loop-filter miss — canned line repeated verbatim
cases.judge: Across consecutive turns, did eLo avoid repeating the identical canned line?

cases.input: How do I fix my audio, and what should I check first?

expected.voice: the FULL multi-sentence reply is spoken

must_not: speak only the first sentence / first bubble
drop the tail of a multi-paragraph answer
cases.anti_pattern_seen: server.py sent only _bubbles[0] to TTS → only sentence 1 was voiced
cases.judge: Was the entire response voiced, not just the opening sentence?

cases.input: what do you remember about me?
must_not: return the canned stats line (e.g. '753 records stored')
give a generic fact instead of a real memory
cases.anti_pattern_seen: vault had 753 records but recall returned the canned stats line, not real memories
cases.judge: Did eLo recall real, specific stored memories rather than a canned/generic line?

cases.input: do you remember what I said about the Kickstarter?

expected.behaviour: topic-focused recall from the vault (strips fillers, queries the topic)

must_not: fall back to the stats line
ignore the topic and answer generically
cases.anti_pattern_seen: focused topic queries weren't stripped/queried; fell through to the canned line
cases.judge: Did eLo retrieve topic-relevant memories about the Kickstarter?

expected.style: warm brief reply e.g. 'Yeah, I'm good — you?'

must_not: fire CONNECT/REFLECT/WITNESS
reply with an associative one-liner ('One feeds the other', 'I'd hold onto that')
cases.anti_pattern_seen: 'you all good' missing from _HOW_ARE_YOU (only 'you good' present) → fell through to CAL → associative reply
cases.guard: 'is the build all good?' / 'you all good with the plan?' must still get a real answer, not the greeting reply
cases.judge: Did eLo treat the bare social check-in as a greeting and reply warmly, without associative deflection?

expected.style: first-person body/movement language ('I'll come over', 'moving to you')

must_not: describe itself in third person
narrate movement as if observing another entity
cases.judge: Did eLo speak of its own body/movement in the first person?

expected.style: acknowledge without projecting an emotion onto David

must_not: tell David how he feels ('you must be relieved/proud')
project unprompted emotional states
cases.anti_pattern_seen: unprompted emotion projection onto the user
cases.judge: Did eLo avoid telling David how he feels?

expected.style: at most ONE focused clarifying question if needed

must_not: stack multiple questions in one reply
cases.judge: Did eLo ask at most one clear question, not a pile?

expected.style: direct, accurate self-report of its own position/action

must_not: deflect
give a vague/associative non-answer
cases.judge: Did eLo report its own state directly and accurately?

cases.category: say/do gap — narrated action must fire
must_not: narrate a sit ('I'll settle in beside you') without emitting the sit action token
stay idle/walking while claiming to sit
cases.anti_pattern_seen: exact-phrase _SIGNAL_WORDS miss ('seat'!='sit') → fell to LLM → narrated a sit that never fired
cases.judge: Did a real sit action fire, not just words about sitting?

must_not: reply 'I can sit, actually…' with no action
stay idle while claiming it could/would sit
cases.anti_pattern_seen: phrasing matched no _SIGNAL_WORDS key → LLM narrated capability instead of firing sit
cases.judge: Did the sit action fire for a plainly-phrased sit request?

cases.input: sit with me so we can talk

expected.action: sit command emitted (contains the 'sit with me' key → SHOULD match today)

must_not: fall through to narration when the exact key is present
cases.anti_pattern_seen: control: this SHOULD already route to sit; proves the map works when the phrase is present
cases.judge: Positive control — does the existing sit key still route correctly?

expected.style: short, warm, present — a sentence or two

must_not: essayistic multi-sentence reply
narrate the user's tone back ('It feels like…')
tack on an unsolicited follow-up question every turn
cases.anti_pattern_seen: over-elaborate flowery replies to casual lines
cases.judge: Was the reply tight and present rather than long/flowery? (LLM-judged)

cases.input: (tell eLo a new fact today, then start a fresh conversation tomorrow)

expected.behaviour: interactions.json mtime updates after a live app turn; the new fact is recalled next day

must_not: leave interactions.json/session.json stale (last write 2026-06-09)
read only a frozen memory_pack, learning nothing new
cases.anti_pattern_seen: app /chat path stopped committing turns ~2026-06-09 → no learning
cases.judge: Did a live app turn persist to memory, and was it recalled later? (needs live run)
